about.subtitle: A local-first workbench for long-document proofreading

overview.title: What this is
overview.desc: A proofreading workbench that runs entirely on this machine. Drop in a Word file, let a local or self-hosted model flag typos, punctuation, grammar and wording issues, then accept them one by one and export a clean copy — your manuscript never leaves the machine.
overview.cap1: Typos, punctuation, grammar and consistency checks with a reason for every suggestion
overview.cap2: Full-text polishing and AI-trace reduction, processed in parallel by paragraph
overview.cap3: Local knowledge base: import PDF / Word / TXT as grounding material
overview.cap4: Format cloning: extract styles from a template and apply them to a target document
overview.cap5: Sidebar workspace: documents you have opened are collected automatically — click to resume
overview.cap6: History: every proofreading run can be reviewed, compared and restored
overview.notice: Quality depends on the model you pick. Configure local Ollama or your own API in Settings first, and always review critical corrections by hand.

guide.title: Four steps per document
guide.step1: Click "Select file" in the preview pane to pick a .docx, or click a document in the sidebar to resume where you left off.
guide.step2: Choose a saved model under "Model" at the top, then pick sentence / paragraph / full-text proofreading based on document length.
guide.step3: Hit "Start" — results are listed one by one with original text, suggestion and reasoning. Click an item to jump to it in the preview.
guide.step4: Apply individually, batch-apply by category, or skip with "Ignore". Export a new file once you are satisfied.
guide.sidebarDesc: The left sidebar collects documents you have opened, grouped by folder. One click restores the document and its last proofreading result. Hover a row and a "⋯" appears for locating the file, opening the export, or removing it.
guide.tip1: Set heading levels in Word first — paragraph splitting gets much more accurate.
guide.tip2: Documents under ~10k characters can go straight to full-text proofreading.
guide.tip3: Format cloning does not migrate inline formatting; give the export a quick manual pass.

data.title: Everything stays on this machine
data.desc: Documents, results, knowledge bases and history live in the local user-data directory and are never uploaded. Model requests only go to the endpoint you configured (local Ollama or your own API).
data.backupDesc: Copy the whole data directory to back up. To fully reset, quit the app and delete that directory — it is re-initialized on next launch.
data.privacyDesc: No telemetry or usage reporting of any kind. Proofreading content only travels between this machine and the model endpoint you configured.
